name: Oaken Fortification
body:
Your flesh is as tough as an ancient oak.

Prerequisites: Plant type, 7 HD, Photosynthetic Healing

Benefit: You flesh grants you a 25% immunity to sneak attacks and critical hits. This does not stack with fortification, rather working separately.

Dwellers in Dream: The Briarborn. Copyright, January 27, 2013, Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian “Necroblivion” Berg, Richard “AWizardInDallas” Hunt
